description_short: The third Monster Hunter Stories RPG follows a Rider caught between two nations and two Skyscale Rathalos, combining exploration, monster raising and strategic turn-based battles.
description_ar: الجزء الثالث من سلسلة Monster Hunter Stories. قم بتربية الـMonsties وبناء الروابط معها واستكشاف عالم واسع وخوض معارك تقمص أدوار بنظام تبادل الأدوار، ضمن قصة دولتين وتوأم من Rathalos يحملان علامة Skyscale.

gameplayPillars.title: Raise and Bond with Monsties
gameplayPillars.description: Hatch, raise and build bonds with monsters that become traversal partners and combat companions.

gameplayPillars.title: Turn-Based Battles
gameplayPillars.description: Use the series' Power, Speed and Technical relationship, exploit enemy patterns and coordinate Rider/Monstie actions.

gameplayPillars.title: Exploration and Riding
gameplayPillars.description: Travel through broad environments using Monstie abilities, discover resources and encounter wild monsters.

gameplayPillars.title: Party and Character Growth
gameplayPillars.description: Develop the Rider, Monsties and companions through equipment, skills, stats and customization.

gameplayPillars.title: Story-Driven RPG
gameplayPillars.description: Follow the conflict between Azuria and Vermeil and the mystery surrounding twin Skyscale Rathalos.

worldSummary: The kingdoms of Azuria and Vermeil face environmental collapse and renewed war. Twin Rathalos carrying the Skyscale mark link the present crisis to a devastating civil war two centuries earlier.

storyChapters.title: Two Nations at the Brink
storyChapters.body: Azuria and Vermeil face ecological collapse and renewed political tension.

storyChapters.title: Twin Skyscale Rathalos
storyChapters.body: An egg thought to hold a single extinct Rathalos instead hatches twins carrying the Skyscale mark associated with a civil war 200 years earlier.

storyChapters.title: A Rider's Journey for the Truth
storyChapters.body: The Rider and a trusted Rathalos cross the threatened world to uncover the truth behind the twins, the old war and the worsening natural crisis.

perfNotes: Switch 2 uses dynamic resolution with an unlocked frame rate. Independent testing commonly reports roughly 30-45 FPS in the overworld, with up to 60 FPS in lighter scenes or battles. Handheld image quality is softer; 720p-class output has been reported, while docked output is around 1080p-class or higher depending on scene and scaling.

faq.q: Is Monster Hunter Stories 3 a mainline action Monster Hunter game?
faq.a: No. Stories is a turn-based RPG spin-off centered on Riders, Monsties, bonds and party building.

faq.q: Does the Switch 2 version support Simplified Chinese?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese among supported languages.
Crowdsourced completion data lists about 44.5 hours for the main story, around 61 hours with extras and around 95 hours for completionist play.
Yes. DLC includes cosmetic packs, the Special Outfits Set and Additional Side Story: Rudy.
Yes. Nintendo lists amiibo compatibility for the Switch 2 version.
The Nintendo Switch 2 store lists one player on a single system; the core campaign is designed as a single-player RPG.

verdictSummary: A feature-rich monster-raising RPG with strong presentation and customization, though Switch 2 performance is less stable than the hardware can ideally deliver.
verdictCons: Switch 2 frame rate is unlocked and often sits around 30-45 FPS in large areas
Portable mode can dip more often in demanding scenes

reviews.quote: Strong critical reception, especially for turn-based combat, character presentation and the creature-raising loop.
The game received a strong critic average; praise centered on combat and its more personal story, with some criticism of filler and open-world density.
English-language Steam user reviews were Very Positive in the post-launch period.
